material_findings: Kibot published license explicitly permits permanent private retention/use of already-delivered data after cancellation/lapse/termination.
Databento historical trials can start usage-based with $125 new-user credits; a monthly market-data plan is not required merely for historical trial access.
Databento full-US Security Master entitlement must be quoted/confirmed; a 1,000-symbol allocation is not assumed sufficient for the required historical universe.
S3 Partners AWS listing is technically attractive and provider-subscription-free, but standard AWS DSA termination terms are incompatible with permanent archive absent amendment.
ORTEX standard terms remain incompatible with the permanent immutable archive.
